utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s still on track, but I need the final list of items before I can say more. Can you send me the latest update?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, yeah—I’ve been meaning to check on that. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: If you’ve got a ladder or a cordless drill, that’d be a huge help. I’m happy to bring the rest over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—lots of folks are pitching in. I can swing by later and see if they still need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be helpful, thanks — I’m just trying to make sure we don’t run short on boxes or space. If you can check what they need most, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you drop off the repair supplies at the community shed on Maple, near the blue mailbox? I’ll keep track of everything from there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll drop the supplies at the community shed on Maple by the blue mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive today. If you want, I can also help set up a quick sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Quinn. Thank you — a sign-up sheet would make it much easier.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put together a simple sign-up sheet and start sharing it around the block today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m lining up the repair drive now and could use your help with a quick list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can help with that. Tell me what’s broken, and I’ll keep it short and practical.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you, Leo. I’ll start with the top priorities and keep the list tight so we can sort the drive efficiently.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m glad to help—can you remind me what’s still needed for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what’s still needed most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mostly supplies and a clear list of the repairs people still need help with.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line things up around school drop-off and pickup. What time does the repair drive need us there?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — that would be a huge help. We should be there by 8:30, if that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 8:30 works for me — I can swing by right after drop-off and be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting organized now—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—folks are sorting tools and making a list of what needs fixing. I can ask around and see who still wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks. I’m still catching up, so any list or updates you hear would really help me pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re bringing the extension cords and the toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got the extension cords and the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks and let them know what you need. Just send me the shortages and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — if I hear anything about the repair drive, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, thanks, Rey — I think we still need to sort the tools and check on the paint, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the rest. Can you help me remember what’s already been set up?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure, I can help sort it out. I’m a bit fuzzy too, but let’s check the tools and paint first and go from there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What time did you say it starts?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I think it starts at 10. If that changed, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, 10 works for me. Just let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: what time are you thinking for the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about Saturday morning around 9? Bring your gloves, and if you’ve got a drill, that’d be handy too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Quinn — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara — could you start by checking in with the folks on Birch and Maple about what needs fixing? I’ll send the invite and coordinate the list once you’ve heard back.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check in with Birch and Maple and report back what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help pull folks together for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Start with the folks on Cedar and Maple—those are the closest to the repair spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it—I’ll start with Cedar and Maple and see who can help closest to the spot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the repair drive organized and we’re ready to start collecting requests. Cleo, if you’ve heard of any urgent fixes on the block, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear of anything urgent on the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated as requests come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s underway, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s underway now, but I don’t have the full rundown yet. I’m planning to check who’s coordinating and what supplies they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—if you hear who’s coordinating, let me know. I’m still piecing it together from the sidelines.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you help by dropping off the donated tools after school, or would the weekend work better for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: After school works for me — I can drop them off then.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?
